english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for transferring, providing, handing over, causing a feeling, or administering something.
For supplying something needed, 畀 is the all-purpose colloquial choice.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent for giving or conferring something.
Use this colloquial choice when the meaning is concretely giving something to a person, especially with an explicit recipient.
Use this in casual requests when the intended meaning is to give or send someone something, such as a link.
